groups.defect: Backup-code authentication uses timing-sensitive indexOf comparisons in both the disable-2FA endpoint and login authorization.
groups.rationale: Both report the same comparison mistake repeated in separate authentication paths. Each location needs its own constant-time comparison change.

groups.defect: Backup-code validation and consumption are not atomic, allowing concurrent logins to reuse or restore consumed codes.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same read-modify-write race in login authorization. The first describes an additional consequence of that race; atomic consumption resolves both.
